From 5d90faf45427dd76fadbe7a4dc4fce3b6f87b550 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sudeep Holla <Sudeep.Holla@arm.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2017 18:18:39 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] perf jvmti: Fix linker error when libelf config is disabled

When libelf is disabled in the configuration, we get the following
linker error:

  LINK     libperf-jvmti.so
  ld: cannot find -lelf
  Makefile.perf:515: recipe for target 'libperf-jvmti.so' failed

Jiri pointed out that both librt and libelf are not really required. So
this patch fixes the linker error by getting rid of unwanted libraries
in the linker stage.

Signed-off-by: Sudeep Holla <sudeep.holla@arm.com>
Acked-by: David Carrillo-Cisneros <davidcc@google.com>
Acked-by: Jiri Olsa <jolsa@kernel.org>
Cc: Alexander Shishkin <alexander.shishkin@linux.intel.com>
Cc: Elena Reshetova <elena.reshetova@intel.com>
Cc: Kees Kook <keescook@chromium.org>
Cc: Paul Turner <pjt@google.com>
Cc: Peter Zijlstra <peterz@infradead.org>
Cc: Stephane Eranian <eranian@google.com>
Cc: Sudeep Holla <sudeep.holla@arm.com>
Cc: Wang Nan <wangnan0@huawei.com>
Fixes: 209045adc2bb ("perf tools: add JVMTI agent library")
Link: http://lkml.kernel.org/r/20170719011839.99399-5-davidcc@google.com
Signed-off-by: Arnaldo Carvalho de Melo <acme@redhat.com>

diff --git a/tools/perf/Makefile.perf b/tools/perf/Makefile.perf
index 100a6c1670c8..d66f90e6be5c 100644
--- a/tools/perf/Makefile.perf
+++ b/tools/perf/Makefile.perf
@@ -518,7 +518,7 @@ $(LIBJVMTI_IN): FORCE
 	$(Q)$(MAKE) -f $(srctree)/tools/build/Makefile.build dir=jvmti obj=jvmti
 
 $(OUTPUT)$(LIBJVMTI): $(LIBJVMTI_IN)
-	$(QUIET_LINK)$(CC) -shared -Wl,-soname -Wl,$(LIBJVMTI) -o $@ $< -lelf -lrt
+	$(QUIET_LINK)$(CC) -shared -Wl,-soname -Wl,$(LIBJVMTI) -o $@ $<
 endif
 
 $(patsubst perf-%,%.o,$(PROGRAMS)): $(wildcard */*.h)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `tools/perf/Makefile.perf`**
   - The line that links the JVMTI library has been modified. The original command included `-lelf -lrt`, which linked against the `libelf` and `librt` libraries. The updated command removes these libraries, resulting in the following change:
     - **Before:** `-lelf -lrt`
     - **After:** (removed entirely)

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the `Makefile.perf` directly addresses a linker error that occurs when the `libelf` configuration is disabled. By removing the unnecessary libraries (`libelf` and `librt`), the patch resolves the issue of the linker failing to find `-lelf`, thus allowing the build process to complete successfully without these dependencies. This change is a direct response to feedback from Jiri, indicating that these libraries were not required for the functionality of the JVMTI agent library.

Here is the commit message:
perf jvmti: Fix linker error when libelf config is disabled

When libelf is disabled in the configuration, we get the following
linker error:

  LINK     libperf-jvmti.so
  ld: cannot find -lelf
  Makefile.perf:515: recipe for target 'libperf-jvmti.so' failed

Jiri pointed out that both librt and libelf are not really required. So
this patch fixes the linker error by getting rid of unwanted libraries
in the linker stage.

Signed-off-by: Sudeep Holla <sudeep.holla@arm.com>
Acked-by: David Carrillo-Cisneros <davidcc@google.com>
Acked-by: Jiri Olsa <jolsa@kernel.org>
Cc: Alexander Shishkin <alexander.shishkin@linux.intel.com>

Cc: Stephane Eranian <eranian@google.com>
Cc: Sudeep Holla <sudeep.holla@arm.com>
Cc: Wang Nan <wangnan0@huawei.com>
Fixes: 209045adc2bb ("perf tools: add JVMTI agent library")
Link: http://lkml.kernel.org/r/20170719011839.99399-5-davidcc@google.com
Signed-off-by: Arnaldo Carvalho de Melo <acme@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the inclusion of unnecessary libraries (`libelf` and `librt`) in the linking stage of the JVMTI agent library, which led to a linker error when `libelf` was disabled in the configuration. This indicates that the build process was incorrectly dependent on `libelf`, which was not required for the library's functionality.

Here is the patch:
 
 $(OUTPUT)$(LIBJVMTI): $(LIBJVMTI_IN)
-	$(QUIET_LINK)$(CC) -shared -Wl,-soname -Wl,$(LIBJVMTI) -o $@ $< -lelf -lrt
+	$(QUIET_LINK)$(CC) -shared -Wl,-soname -Wl,$(LIBJVMTI) -o $@ $<
 endif

```makefile
-lrt
```
Reason:
The inclusion of `-lelf` and `-lrt` in the linking command indicates that the build process is incorrectly dependent on these libraries. When `libelf` is disabled in the configuration, the linker cannot find `libelf`, resulting in a linker error.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```makefile
+	$(QUIET_LINK)$(CC) -shared -Wl,-soname -Wl,$(LIBJVMTI) -o $@ $<
```
Reason:
By removing `-lelf` and `-lrt` from the linking command, the build process no longer attempts to link against these unnecessary libraries, thus preventing the linker error when `libelf` is disabled. This change ensures that the library is built without dependencies that are not required for its functionality.
